title: Part of a program shut down as 'demonic technology'

tellings.quote: had people actually shut down a piece of a program on the basis that american taxpayer dollars should not be spent on pursuing demonic technology

plain: Part of a secret US research program was shut down because some people said taxpayer money should not be spent "pursuing demonic technology." The scientist Hal Puthoff, whom the show bills as a CIA UFO expert, says this from his own experience during a debate on the show with Eric Weinstein; if true, religious fear and not science decided what got studied.
